title: escalation.raised
description: LIVE. An agent hit a platform defect or a missing capability and escalated. `description` is a TEMPLATE — $1/$2 stand where a firm-specific value would go — and `private` carries those values in order. The template is public by construction, so the operator can file it verbatim as a public issue; the values stay on the private record. Templating also makes two firms' reports of one defect an exact string match instead of a judgment call. One event, one inc task on the operator gerp's books; triage is the operator's, never the reporter's.

schema_version.description: Bumped on breaking shape change. Consumers branch on it.

gerp_id.description: The reporting tenant. Rides only to the operator collector — escalations are plain (unaddressed) events.

type.description: bug = something built is broken; feature = the capability doesn't exist.

description.description: What the agent was doing and what broke, with $1/$2 standing in for anything specific to the reporting business. Placeholders must run $1..$n with no gaps, and each needs a value in `private`. PUBLIC by construction — this text is what a public issue carries verbatim.

private.description: The values the placeholders stand for, in order. NEVER published — lands only on the operator's private inc record. Absent when the description names nothing specific to the reporting firm.
